data_science.title: FlowLOB: Efficient and Controllable Limit Order Book Generation with Flow Matching
data_science.why_trending: Novel flow-matching approach to LOB generation combines realistic market dynamics with computational efficiency and controllable scenario generation—directly applicable to high-frequency trading simulation.

data_science.title: Huber-Wasserstein barycenters for robust distribution-valued data
data_science.why_trending: Introduces Huber-Wasserstein barycenters for robust distribution analysis, bridging robust statistics and optimal transport with practical applications to heterogeneous data.

data_science.title: Statistical Properties of Robust Learning under Distributional Shifts
data_science.why_trending: First systematic study of finite-sample guarantees for DRO and robust satisficing under distributional shifts, filling a critical gap in understanding robust learning frameworks.

data_science.title: WIRED: Weighted Adaptive Prediction with Structured Dependence for Probabilistic Multiseries Forecasting
data_science.why_trending: WIRED package presents practical copula-based ensemble approach for multi-series probabilistic forecasting with comprehensive benchmark evaluation and software implementation.

data_science.title: Learning Discrete Decisions for MIPs with Constraint-Aware Diffusion
data_science.why_trending: First diffusion-based approach to mixed-integer optimization integrating constraint feasibility directly into the reverse process, advancing neural combinatorial solvers.

finance.title: Diffusion Models in Finance: A Survey
finance.why_trending: Comprehensive survey of diffusion models in finance across time series, LOBs, and option surfaces—timely consolidation of rapidly emerging generative paradigm with Itô calculus alignment.

finance.title: Regime-Gated Residual Mixture-of-Experts for Cross-Sectional Volatility Forecasting
finance.why_trending: RG-ResMoE demonstrates regime-dependent volatility forecasting with careful ablations across 1,027 equities; shows neural networks can capture market regimes without destabilizing training.

finance.title: Beyond the Skew-Stickiness Ratio: Transport Geometry of Spot-Driven Variance Surface Dynamics
finance.why_trending: Develops transport-geometric theory of implied variance surface dynamics, unifying classical stickiness regimes through higher-order transport coefficients—novel theoretical perspective.

finance.title: Simulating Stress Laws under Extremal Dependence: Characterizing What Generative Models Must Preserve
finance.why_trending: Shows stress-scenario generation under extremal dependence requires preserving tail dependence measure; critical for risk modeling in heavy-tailed regimes.

finance.title: DYSANOS Generative Dynamic Smooth Arbitrage-free Non-parametric Option Surfaces
finance.why_trending: DYSANOS is first generative market model producing arbitrage-free option surfaces across all strikes and expiries for multi-year paths, advancing synthetic market simulation.

social_sciences.title: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT
social_sciences.why_trending: First large-scale empirical study linking ChatGPT Enterprise adoption records to worker roles and tasks across 1,500+ organizations—unprecedented data on how firms use frontier AI.

social_sciences.title: Breaking the Chain: Division Norms and Criminal Deterrence
social_sciences.why_trending: Models organized crime deterrence through division norms and membership dynamics, introducing novel application of game theory to law enforcement resource allocation.

social_sciences.title: Training AI For When Humans Will Use It
social_sciences.why_trending: Frames AI economic value through its interaction with surrounding decision environment; shows optimal training can be discontinuous in economic parameters—bridges AI capability to human use.

social_sciences.title: Measuring the Arrow of Time: Identification, Estimation, and Inference for Directional Structure in Multivariate Time Series
social_sciences.why_trending: Develops complete framework for measuring directionality in coupled time series via time-reversal asymmetry; answers causality question without structural assumptions.

social_sciences.title: Organizational Technology Ladders: Remote Work and Generative AI Adoption
social_sciences.why_trending: Shows remote-work adoption during COVID shaped later generative AI uptake; introduces 'organizational technology ladder' concept with IV identification of causal effect.

topics.name: Generative models for financial data
topics.summary: Diffusion and flow-matching approaches for generating realistic financial data including limit order books, option surfaces, and time series with controllable scenarios and arbitrage-free properties.

topics.name: Robust learning under distribution shift
topics.summary: Methods for maintaining model performance under domain shift, distributional changes, and tail risks through robust optimization, Wasserstein-based approaches, and chance constraints.

topics.name: Volatility and option surface forecasting
topics.summary: Neural and classical approaches to forecasting implied volatility surfaces, regime-dependent dynamics, and the impact of macroeconomic events like FOMC announcements.

topics.name: AI adoption and organizational change
topics.summary: Empirical and theoretical studies of how organizations adopt and integrate frontier AI tools, including technology ladders, worker roles, and alignment with decision-making contexts.

topics.name: Probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification
topics.summary: Methods for multi-series probabilistic forecasting, feature importance assessment, calibration, and inference under measurement error or model misspecification.

topics.name: Game theory and mechanism design
topics.summary: Equilibrium concepts, strategic interaction models, and optimal mechanism design for diverse settings from market competition to queue management and matching problems.

topics.name: Causal inference and mediation analysis
topics.summary: Methods for decomposing treatment effects, identifying causality under interference and temporal dependence, and handling time-to-event outcomes with structured confounding.

topics.name: Neural network optimization and efficiency
topics.summary: Techniques for reducing parameter counts, inference costs, and improving sample efficiency in deep learning through token merging, self-distillation, and constraint-aware generation.

topics.name: Stress testing and tail risk
topics.summary: Methods for scenario generation under extremal dependence, early warning systems for systemic risk, and network-based stress indices that capture rare-event correlations.

topics.name: AI governance, explainability and verification
topics.summary: Frameworks for governing self-adapting AI systems, model risk management under continuous updates, relational verification of neural networks, and telemetry architectures.
